candidates.text: Why can a classic precipitating foehn leave warmer, drier air on the lee side at the same elevation?

candidates.explanation_en: In the classic precipitating case, latent heat offsets windward cooling and the dried parcel warms faster during descent. This explains a warm/dry lee result without claiming every foehn needs rain.
